code:
This project replaced three conflicting ad-hoc queries
with one governed, tested semantic layer that Finance,
Marketing, and Product all now use, and fixed a real
revenue-counting bug along the way.

It did not add production alerting beyond CI, a
self-service metrics tool, or a plan for the legacy
SQL Server source's own reliability -- named gaps for
a future phase, not oversights we're pretending don't exist.
caption: Not every problem solved -- every remaining one named, owned, and handed off.
